worst = 0
for secret in range(1, 100 + 1):
    lo = 1
    hi = 100
    guess = 0
    times = 0
    while guess != secret:
        guess = (lo + hi) // 2
        times += 1
        if guess < secret:
            lo = guess + 1
        elif guess > secret:
            hi = guess - 1
    worst = max(worst, times)
print(worst)
